using CUDA, JSON3
u = CUDA.zeros(1024, 4)
function k1!(a)
    a[1] = a[1] + 1.0
    return nothing
end
function events(f)
    f(); CUDA.synchronize()
    pr = nothing
    for src in ("g -> CUDA.@profile io=devnull trace=true g()", "g -> CUDA.@profile trace=true g()")
        try
            fn = Core.eval(Main, Meta.parse(src)); pr = Base.invokelatest(fn, f); break
        catch e
        end
    end
    dev = pr.device; host = pr.host
    nm = String.(collect(dev.name)); hn = String.(collect(host.name))
    d = Dict{String,Int}(); for n in nm; d[n] = get(d, n, 0) + 1; end
    h = Dict{String,Int}(); for n in hn; h[n] = get(h, n, 0) + 1; end
    return Dict("device" => d, "host_api" => h, "n_kern" => count(n -> !startswith(n, "["), nm), "n_copy" => count(n -> startswith(n, "["), nm))
end
res = Dict{String,Any}("device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())), "cuda_jl" => string(pkgversion(CUDA)))
N = 1000
res["read_2d_scalar"] = events(() -> begin for i in 1:N; CUDA.@allowscalar u[i, 2]; end end)
res["write_2d_scalar"] = events(() -> begin for i in 1:N; CUDA.@allowscalar (u[i, 2] = 1.0); end end)
res["read_modify_write"] = events(() -> begin for i in 1:N; CUDA.@allowscalar (u[i, 2] = u[i, 2] + 1.0); end end)
res["one_thread_launch"] = events(() -> begin for i in 1:N; @cuda threads = 1 blocks = 1 k1!(u); end end)
res["push_read"] = events(() -> begin v = Float64[]; for i in 1:N; CUDA.@allowscalar push!(v, u[i, 2]); end end)
res["N"] = N
println(JSON3.write(res))
